= = 
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PARTHA SARTHY  ORAL ORDER 2 13-09-2024 1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. The petitioner has renewed his prayer for grant of regular bail in connection with Pipra P.S Case no. 279 of 2023 registered under sections 420, 399, 402, 413, 414, 468, 469 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code and sections 25(1-B)(a), 26 and 35 of the Arms Act.
3. As per the prosecution case, a loaded country made pistol was recovered from the possession of the petitioner.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that t he earlier application for bail of the petitioner was rejected vide order dated 24.1.2024 (Annexure-1) passed in Cr. Misc. no.1287 of 2024, giving liberty to the petitioner to renew his prayer for bail after six months.
No incriminating article has been recovered from the petitioner's possession, who has been falsely implicated in the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58530 of 2024(2) dt.13-09-2024 case.
5. The prayer for bail is opposed by learned A.P.P for the State.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the nature of allegation against the petitioner in the F.I.R, the liberty granted in the earlier order of rejection dated 24.1.2024, the petitioner having remained in custody since 12.9.2023 and charge-sheet having been submitted in the case, the petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in connection with Pipra P.S Case no. 279 of 2023 on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, East Champaran, Motihari.
